error.summary: Mixed banks reveal the answer by copying the prompt’s sole positive numeral: 14/14 fresh mixed questions and all 5 delivered batch questions. Earlier defects are repaired. Package files remain unchanged. Full report: result.json.

source_analysis.skill: Translate inhibited-growth prose into dX/dt=k(a-X), identifying the equilibrium and selecting the correct equation.
reasoning_steps: Identify the dependent quantity and equilibrium.
Distinguish equilibrium from any initial stock.
Recognize positive growth proportional to the remaining gap.
Select the equation with the appropriate capacity, sign and population factors.
invariants: Positive proportionality constant and growth from below equilibrium.
One whole-equation radio response from five choices.
permitted_variations: Context, capacity, variable, units and below-capacity initial stock.
Correct option position and eligible equilibrium assignments.
Wrong structural equations may share the correct equilibrium without becoming correct.

decision_variation.details: Numeral copying perfectly predicts correctness within mixed templates and across the delivered batch. Filtering and learner selection preserve the cue. Captured inventory contains no generated easy instances; all ten stored generated moderate/hard records were reproduced.

findings.description: Mixed banks assign distinct capacities to every option, so only the correct equation contains the prompt’s sole positive numeral. Copying that numeral bypasses sign and population-factor reasoning. It solves 14/14 fresh mixed questions and all 5 batch survivors. This finding does not reject the source’s legitimate all-capacity equilibrium-selection task.
findings.reproduction: From evidence_root run /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python -B reproduce_number_match.py --output number-match-results.json; expected exit 1. Minimal case: generate_easy(seed=3, parameters={"context":"deer","capacity":60}). Options are k(60-N), -k(84-N), -k(89+N), k(91-N), k(66-N); only the correct option contains 60. Add --input delivery-batch/accepted.json to reproduce the delivered 5/5 failure.
findings.requested_change: Revise mixed-bank construction so wrong structural equations can share the stated equilibrium and learners must inspect sign/factor relationships. Require distinct equations rather than distinct constants. Preserve competing-capacity variation and the original length regressions, retain the new numeral-copy regression, and regenerate the batch.
